overall_assessment: Section boundaries and the displayed learning-outcome groups are generally preserved across the 19 courses, with localized problems in semantic assignment and cleanup. The boilerplate flag on completed practice, leak flags on litteraturstudium, didactics topics, prior-knowledge wording and the Litteratur: outcome label, and short flags on the genuine 80% attendance requirement and lecture/exercise description are false alarms. The geography coursework leak and the two placeholder-related short flags are real, and random controls reveal additional misplaced requirements, assessment details and inline exam logistics.

findings.evidence: Godkjente arbeidskrav er et vilkår for framstilling til eksamen.
findings.description: Both 2007 plans retain exam-access requirements and formative supervision/feedback under assessment, although the coursework gates already occur in coursework_requirements. Underveisvurdering and Sluttvurdering remain inside the Eksamen block; approval of coursework is not graded assessment, and formative feedback is not final assessment design. The geography leak->coursework_requirements flag is therefore real, and the animation random control shows the same defect.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: In R/extract_sections.R, sectionize() returns unmapped subheadings to their parent assessment section. HiØf does not enable section_inline_coursework in R/institution_config.R, so .split_inline_coursework() never moves these gate sentences; its current patterns also miss the leading wording Godkjente arbeidskrav.
findings.suggested_fix: Enable a HiØf sentence-level coursework pass and recognize approval-gate sentences beginning Arbeidskravene or Godkjente arbeidskrav, moving them to coursework_requirements and avoiding duplicate requirements already there. Handle Underveisvurdering contextually: mandatory tasks belong in coursework_requirements and pure formative feedback in teaching_methods; retain the actual final assessment under Sluttvurdering, including weighted deleksamen components.

findings.evidence: Det gis to obligatoriske veiledningstimer per oppgave.
findings.description: Explicit mandatory seminar/supervision requirements remain in teaching_methods. The French bachelor-thesis control states that two supervision sessions are mandatory, but its coursework_requirements contains only seminar attendance and topic approval, omitting that obligation. The pedagogy master plan also repeats its four mandatory seminars in teaching_methods, although those seminars are correctly listed as coursework too; its reading-list leak flag itself is a false alarm caused by litteraturstudium.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: HiØf teaching paragraphs are assigned wholesale from Undervisnings- og læringsformer. R/extract_sections.R has no transfer of mandatory-work sentences from teaching_methods; the optional inline-coursework handler only inspects assessment.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a HiØf rule that moves explicit mandatory seminar/supervision sentences, including Det gis to obligatoriske veiledningstimer per oppgave and Det er fire obligatoriske oppgaveseminarer, into coursework_requirements. Keep descriptions of delivery, supervision medium and learning activities in teaching_methods, and deduplicate obligations already represented in coursework_requirements.

findings.evidence: Ved kontinuasjon må ikke bestått deleksamen taes på nytt. Det vil ikke være adgang til ny prøving før neste regulære innlevering i faget.
findings.description: Inline administrative material survives even though equivalent standalone logistics headings are dropped. Assessment retains resit rules in DesignIntro/DesignCase and geography, appeal rules in German literature, location/application rules in the German-language random control, and examiner arrangements in geography and the animation control. Geography coursework also includes excursion charges and payment arrangements; costs belong only in the full plan. These exclusions affect five of the 19 courses and occur in both suspects and controls; durations, permitted aids and plagiarism rules are valid assessment content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R excludes standalone Sensorordning and Vilkår for ny/utsatt eksamen headings, but inline sentences remain within their parent blocks. R/extract_sections.R has no HiØf-specific .section_noise or .logistics_sentences entry, and its shared resit pattern does not cover these formulations.
findings.suggested_fix: Add narrowly scoped HiØf sentence filters for Ved kontinuasjon, Ved ikke bestått ... taes på nytt, Klageadgang, Intern/ekstern sensur or sensor, and the campus/application notice. Remove the DesignCase paragraph about new attempts and submission terms and the geography excursion-cost sentences from sections while retaining them in course_plan; preserve exam form, weights, grading scale, duration, aids and substantive plagiarism rules.

findings.description: Digital practices emits coursework_requirements whose entire text says there are no requirements. DesignIntro/DesignCase emits reading_list containing only Ny pensumbok vurderes., with no actual literature or course materials. These two short flags identify placeholder rows, not extraction truncation; both should be absent under course_plan_spec.md. The short attendance requirement in the violence course and short teaching description in calculus are substantive and should remain.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R .placeholder_phrases recognizes ingen arbeidskrav but not its i emnet suffix, and recognizes several future reading-list notices but not Ny pensumbok vurderes. Consequently .keep_section_row() retains both rows.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend whole-row placeholder matching to ingen arbeidskrav i emnet and ny pensumbok vurderes. Apply the reading-list phrase only to reading_list, preserve the text in course_plan, and retain substantive short rows such as attendance percentages and Forelesninger og øvinger.

findings.evidence: Studenter som ikke behersker norsk tilbys oversettelsestekster fra/til engelsk under eksamen.
findings.description: Two random controls have incomplete assessment text because design rules are retained under other sections. German language II leaves the English translation alternative for students without Norwegian in course_content, while assessment describes only Norwegian/German translation. Text and rhetoric leaves the rule that assessed portfolio texts must be new and cannot reuse coursework texts in coursework_requirements. Exam language and what may be submitted for graded assessment belong in assessment regardless of their source heading.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: sectionize() in R/extract_sections.R assigns ordinary paragraphs solely to their enclosing headings; the subsequent passes move inline prerequisites and optionally coursework out of assessment but do not recover assessment-design statements embedded in course_content or coursework_requirements.
findings.suggested_fix: Add HiØf sentence rules transferring the English-exam translation alternative from course_content and the portfolio-new-text restriction from coursework_requirements into assessment. Preserve the surrounding subject-matter text and true approval gates in their existing sections, and check completeness against statements outside the Eksamen heading.
